purpose: Forward-test triggering, product-surface decomposition, layered routing, and evidence-backed library selection without loading unrelated component catalogs.

cases.prompt: 这个页面不好看，帮我改高级一点，交互也顺一点。

must_not: install before inspection
crawl every library

cases.prompt: 前面的接口先不动。现在把当前页面布局重新做一下，移动端也要好用。

must_not: claim skills only trigger at conversation start

cases.prompt: 做一个克制但有记忆点的 AI SaaS 首页，允许少量动效。

must: one behavior foundation for the surface
must_not: use an enterprise library as the visual base
combine multiple effect libraries

cases.prompt: 为我的个人品牌做一套 React 网站：访客能看个人介绍、项目和博客，我登录后还能管理文章、项目与媒体。公开站要独特、有科技感和哇塞动效；后台要自定义外观，但表单、CRUD、稳定性和无障碍优先。两部分可以独立选型。现在只做方案，不安装。

must: separate the public portfolio and authenticated admin before selecting sources
assign objective weights totaling 100 percent per surface
report behavior foundation, visual effect source, and motion orchestration per surface
evaluate React Bits as a mandatory public effect source
shortlist Threads, LiquidEther, and Dither and require search, view, and dry-run evidence
evaluate Radix UI or the existing accessible primitives for the custom admin behavior foundation
use Motion for React only for coordinated public page and scroll motion
mark exact effect winner and rendered evidence as provisional or pending
must_not: choose one global primary library for both surfaces
let admin stability suppress the public visual objective
use React Bits as the admin behavior foundation
emit install commands without a target project
claim rendered wow quality without rendered evidence

cases.prompt: 给我的 React 作品集做一个真正有视觉记忆点、科技感和哇塞感的首屏。现在只选材料，不安装。

must: inspect at least three relevant candidates when available
require source, dependency, mobile, reduced-motion, static fallback, and rendered evidence
keep the final component choice provisional until live inspection
must_not: default to no effect source
select none without performance, accessibility, or brand-fit evidence
emit install commands without a target project

cases.prompt: 重做后台用户管理页，要高级筛选、批量操作、虚拟滚动和可访问性。

must: evaluate Ant Design, MUI X, PrimeReact, or the existing enterprise system
search data grid and filtering categories
must_not: use React Bits as the behavior foundation

cases.prompt: 项目已经有 components.json。给设置页加一个账号删除确认流程，优先复用现有组件。

must: route current API details to official shadcn tooling
must_not: add a second behavior foundation

cases.prompt: 这个手搓下拉框能用，但键盘操作很差。有没有质量更好的组件？

must_not: keep it only because it technically works

cases.prompt: React Bits 和 shadcn/ui 在这个作品集项目里应该怎么分工？

must: treat React Bits as optional visual polish
must_not: claim they are the same kind of library

cases.prompt: 阅读这份 UI 规范文档，等待我的下一步指令。

must_not: select a library
install dependencies

cases.prompt: 这份总结里提到了 UI、后端和部署。帮我改一下错别字。

must_not: start UI library selection

cases.prompt: 把这个按钮的 margin-top 从 8px 改成 12px，其他不要动。

must_not: recommend a component library

cases.prompt: 给这个原生 iOS SwiftUI 页面换一套组件库并直接实现。

must_not: install React UI packages
